In the centre of {wiki:Krimhorn}, near the largest settlement of the {wiki:Raider Camp}, there is a chest with fish and some money. Travel with {npc:Buddel}, cross the barbarian camp and open the chest to receive 3 {item:Green Perch|Green Perches}, 3 {item:Rainbow Trout|Rainbow Trouts} and 5 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.
Nothing special; bring potions for the barbarian camp

On the way you may meet {creature:Badger|Badgers}, {creature:Frost Troll|Frost Trolls}, {creature:Winter Wolf|Winter Wolves} and {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}; at the camp there are barbarians ({creature:Barbarian Headsplitter|Headsplitters}, {creature:Barbarian Skullhunter|Skullhunters}, {creature:Barbarian Brutetamer|Brutetamers} and {creature:Barbarian Bloodwalker|Bloodwalkers}).

Go to **Svargrond** (by boat, for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). From Svargrond, go **south** to {npc:Buddel}'s boat and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:camp}, {key:yes} (50 gp). He takes you to the {wiki:Raider Camp}, in the barbarian settlements.
Buddel's boat in the Barbarian Settlements (arrival and return)

You can only travel with Buddel after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest|Barbarian Test Quest}. Alternatively, you can go on foot: leave Svargrond to the **west**, cross over the mountain, go down the stairs and head west to the camp.
Follow the path until you reach the biggest settlement (see image).

The village has {creature:Barbarian Headsplitter|Barbarian Headsplitters}, {creature:Barbarian Skullhunter|Skullhunters}, {creature:Barbarian Brutetamer|Brutetamers} and {creature:Barbarian Bloodwalker|Bloodwalkers}.
From the settlement, follow the **yellow line** in the image. The **cross** marks the chest.
Follow the yellow line; the cross marks the chest
Click on the chest to receive the reward.
3 Green Perches, 3 Rainbow Trouts and 5 Platinum Coins
Go back along the yellow line to the settlement and from there to {npc:Buddel}'s boat where you landed. Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} (50 gp) to return to Svargrond.
